title: Error Typing for Smarter Rewards: Improving Process Reward Models with Error-Aware Hierarchical Supervision
paper_type_zh: 过程/轨迹监督数据与过程奖励研究
best_for_zh: 构建、审计或复用步骤级推理反馈数据的研究者。
one_line: Error Typing for Smarter Rewards: Improving Process Reward Models with Error-Aware Hierarchical Supervision exposes process or trace supervision data.
提出 PathFinder-PRM：先区分数学错误与一致性错误，再估计步骤正确性，并用三维标签构建 40 万条分层过程监督数据。
why: It makes intermediate reasoning feedback auditable before reuse.
inclusion_reason: Process/trace supervision data release or data-construction method.

title: Problem
问题
html: Flat step labels do not capture how an early error propagates through a long solution. Pathfinder asks how hierarchical, error-aware supervision can locate failures at different granularities and provide better credit assignment for PRMs.
扁平的步骤标签无法刻画早期错误如何在长解答中传播。Pathfinder 研究如何用分层、错误感知的监督在不同粒度定位失败，并为过程奖励模型提供更好的信用分配。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: PathFinder-PRM constructs about 400,000 hierarchical error-aware process examples that distinguish first-error steps from error propagation. It combines PRM800K with model traces and labels steps as correct, first-error, or contaminated subsequent steps. It turns sparse outcome feedback into a supervision contract localised to the reasoning process, supporting training and revealing where a model begins to diverge.
核心贡献是：提出 PathFinder-PRM，并构造约 40 万条分层错误感知过程数据，区分首错步骤与错误传播。 数据对象可概括为：它结合 PRM800K 与模型轨迹，将步骤标记为正确、首错或受污染的后续步骤，并以分层目标学习不同错误角色。 它把“最终答案是否正确”的稀疏反馈改写为可定位到推理过程的监督契约，因而既能服务训练，也能暴露模型在何一步开始偏离。

title: Method
方法
html: It localises failure sources more accurately, trains PRMs, and avoids re-rewarding superficially correct statements after an earlier error during search. Inputs normally include the problem, an existing trace, and intermediate states; outputs are step labels, comparative preferences, or continuous rewards. The generator, terminal verifier, sampling budget, and filtering rules should be checked separately because together they determine label meaning.
方法上，用于更准确地定位失败来源、训练过程奖励模型，以及在搜索时避免把后续表面正确语句重新加分。 训练或使用阶段，用于更准确地定位失败来源、训练过程奖励模型，以及在搜索时避免把后续表面正确语句重新加分。 输入通常包括题目、已有轨迹与中间状态；输出是步骤标签、比较偏好或连续奖励。应分别核验生成器、终局验证器、采样预算与过滤规则，因为它们共同决定标签含义。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The verifiable evidence for “Error Typing for Smarter Rewards: Improving Process Reward Models with Error-Aware Hierarchical Supervision” begins with its 2025 publication record in Findings of EMNLP 2025. The release is catalogued as a documented feedback resource, and the official record identifies a data release, official code, a project page. These materials establish the provenance and accessibility of the resource described by the paper. They do not by themselves measure a universal improvement: the strength of a reported result depends on the paper’s task distribution, supervision design, model setting, and evaluation protocol. Any comparison of later systems therefore needs to preserve the released data version and the conditions under which the paper’s evidence was collected. The publication and its official artifacts provide the traceable basis for that interpretation and comparison.

《Error Typing for Smarter Rewards: Improving Process Reward Models with Error-Aware Hierarchical Supervision》的可追溯证据首先来自其 2025 年在 Findings of EMNLP 2025 发表或发布的记录。该发布被归入有文档说明的反馈资源，官方记录标明其提供数据发布、官方代码和项目页。这些材料能够说明论文所述资源的来源和可访问状态，却不能单独度量普遍性能提升。任何结果的力度仍取决于论文采用的任务分布、监督设计、模型设置和评测协议。比较后续系统时，需要保留发布版本以及论文收集证据时的条件。论文和其官方工件共同构成解释这些结果时可回溯的依据，也明确限定了结论能够追溯的材料范围。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Compared with assigning a whole chain of thought one correct-or-incorrect label, this work changes the unit or acquisition path of process evidence. PathFinder-PRM constructs about 400,000 hierarchical error-aware process examples that distinguish first-error steps from error propagation. It combines PRM800K with model traces and labels steps as correct, first-error, or contaminated subsequent steps. This is its direction signal; the reusable contribution is the data contract, quality control, and evaluation boundary.
相对把整条 CoT 只标为对或错的做法，该工作改变的是过程数据的采集或使用单位。提出 PathFinder-PRM，并构造约 40 万条分层错误感知过程数据，区分首错步骤与错误传播。 这也是它进入 Process / Trace Supervision Data 的原因；但“使用过程奖励”本身并非新意，真正应复用的是其数据契约、质量控制与评测边界。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Automatically augmented data inherit biases in original labels and model traces; propagated-error definitions are not always unique for equivalent derivations or correctable paths. Process scores are auxiliary signals for training or search, not replacements for executable verification, human review, or domain-expert judgment. Before cross-domain use, labels should be sampled and checked against real target-task errors.
局限需要与贡献一并阅读：自动扩增的数据继承原始标签与模型轨迹偏差；“传播错误”定义对等价推导和可纠错路径并不总是唯一。 过程分数是训练或搜索的辅助信号，不能替代可执行验证、人工审核或领域专家判断。跨领域使用前，至少应抽样检查标签是否仍对应目标任务中的真实错误。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For data researchers, the paper is a concrete recipe to compare: state granularity, candidate source, label or preference construction, negative examples, and acceptance criteria. For model builders it can support PRM training, best-of-N reranking, tree search, and trace filtering. For evaluators, first-error localization and calibration matter more than answer accuracy alone.
对数据研究者，最直接的价值是把该工作当成一份可比较的数据配方：明确状态粒度、候选来源、标签或偏好产生机制、负例构造和验收指标。对模型研究者，它可用于 PRM 训练、best-of-N 重排、树搜索和轨迹过滤；对评测者，则应优先报告首错定位与校准而非只报最终正确率。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: A productive reading order is to inspect availability and provenance first, then trace context and label evidence, and only then study the reported gain. Compare the design with PRM800K, rollout-derived labels, and preference-tree supervision. Finally, inspect high-scoring wrong traces to determine whether the verifier learned reasoning quality or superficial style, length, and answer leakage.
阅读时建议先检查数据对象是否可获得、样本是否保留原始上下文、标签是否可追溯到验证证据，再看模型提升。其次比较它与 PRM800K、自动 rollout 标签和偏好树方法的差异。最后手工抽取若干高分错误轨迹，判断奖励模型到底识别了推理质量，还是偏好了格式、长度或答案泄漏。
